title: A ticket for the garden bus
instructions: 原创模拟情境，非官方试题；这是独立分科短测，不是40题完整试卷。开始前不看正文、原音、词表或答案。先独立完成8题并保存原始答案，提交后再核对依据。难度是编写目标，尚未经真实考生标定。
transcript:
Clerk: Good morning. Where do you want to go?
Mara: To Hill Garden, please.
Clerk: The next bus leaves at ten. It is the number four.
Mara: Is the ticket three pounds?
Clerk: That is a child's ticket. An adult ticket is five pounds.
Mara: One adult ticket, please. Where do I wait?
Clerk: At the stop beside the bank. The journey takes twenty minutes.
Mara: Can I buy food at the garden?
Clerk: There is a café, but it is closed today. Please take a sandwich. The garden closes at six. The last bus back is at half past five.
Mara: Thank you. I have my lunch with me.

questions.explanation: 目的地是 Hill Garden，银行是候车点附近的地标。

questions.prompt: 下一班车几点开？写一个英文单词。

questions.prompt: 应乘几路车？写一个英文单词。
questions.explanation: four 是路线编号，不是票价。

questions.evidence: An adult ticket is five pounds.
questions.explanation: 三镑是儿童票，成人票五镑。

questions.evidence: At the stop beside the bank.

questions.prompt: 车程是多少分钟？写一个英文单词。
questions.explanation: twenty 是车程而不是发车钟点。

options: There is no café at the garden.

questions.explanation: 有咖啡馆，但当天不营业；没有价格信息。

questions.evidence: The last bus back is at half past five.
questions.explanation: 花园六点关门，但末班车五点半。
